releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.43 - InMobi Static/Carousel Ad Parity & Dual-Zone Watchdog Rescue
releaseNotes:
* InMobi AdChoices Badge Rejection: Eliminates false-positive detection of Google AdChoices (abgc) circular icons in top-right corners, ensuring genuine close glyphs are targeted
* InMobi Top-Left Skip & Carousel Engine: Direct vision perception and high-contrast corner glyph isolation for InMobi carousel skip buttons at (103, 175) and (84, 312)
* Dynamic InMobi Detection: Automated classification for InMobiAdActivity and webview ad containers
* Dual-Zone Watchdog Auto-Rescue: Real-time supervisor detects unhandled InMobi static ads and executes instantaneous Top-Left rescue clicks
* Immediate Alternate-Corner Fallback: Automatically shifts to opposite top-left corner within 200ms if a top-right dismissal attempt fails on static ads
* 100% On-Device & Zero-Cloud: All OCR, contour geometry, and supervisor operations run fully offline on the local neural hardware
